svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Data Model
svg.desc: gems is the centre: gem_versions, eval_cases, eval_runs and runs point at it; run_events belong to runs; memories link to runs and gems loosely; pipelines own pipeline_runs by name, whose attempts hold run ids.
svg.text: The same tables in SQLite on this PC and in Supabase Postgres • RLS on, no policies
append only; a revert is a new row
dashed: a link by name or inside JSON, no foreign key
